film_locations: Holds film location records; one row per film/location instance (grain: title + locations entry) with keys/measures: title, release_year, locations, fun_facts, production_company, distributor, director, writer, actor_1, actor_2, actor_3.
bikeshare_stations: Holds bike-share station metadata; one row per station (grain: station_id) with keys/measures: station_id, name, latitude, longitude, dockcount, landmark, installation_date.
street_trees: Holds street tree inventory entries; one row per tree (grain: tree_id) with keys/measures: tree_id, legal_status, species, address, site_order, site_info, plant_type, care_taker, care_assistant, plant_date, dbh, plot_size, permit_notes, x_coordinate, y_coordinate, latitude, longitude, location.
sfpd_incidents: Holds police incident reports; one row per incident record (grain: unique_key) with keys/measures: unique_key, category, descript, dayofweek, pddistrict, resolution, address, longitude, latitude, location, pdid, timestamp.
bikeshare_status: Holds real-time bike-share availability snapshots; one row per station snapshot (grain: station_id + time) with keys/measures: station_id, bikes_available, docks_available, time.
bikeshare_trips: Holds bike-share trip records; one row per trip (grain: trip_id) with keys/measures: trip_id, duration_sec, start_date, start_station_name, start_station_id, end_date, end_station_name, end_station_id, bike_number, zip_code, subscriber_type.
311_service_requests: Holds 311 service request records; one row per request (grain: unique_key) with keys/measures: unique_key, created_date, closed_date, resolution_action_updated_date, status, status_notes, agency_name, category, complaint_type, descriptor, incident_address, supervisor_district, neighborhood, location, source, media_url, latitude, longitude, police_district.
sffd_service_calls: Holds fire department service call records; one row per call/unit dispatch (grain: call_number or row_id) with keys/measures: call_number, unit_id, incident_number, call_type, call_date, watch_date, received_timestamp, entry_timestamp, dispatch_timestamp, response_timestamp, on_scene_timestamp, transport_timestamp, hospital_timestamp, call_final_disposition, available_timestamp, address, city, zipcode_of_incident, battalion, station_area, box, original_priority, priority, final_priority, als_unit, call_type_group, number_of_alarms, unit_type, unit_sequence_in_call_dispatch, fire_prevention_district, supervisor_district, neighborhood_district, location, row_id, latitude, longitude.
